correctness.rationale: For every real non-diagonal 2x2 SPD system, positive diagonal congruence and sign conjugacy reduce to A=[[1,rho],[rho,1]]. Generalized SSOR eigenvalues have constant product 1-rho² and sum 2-rho² omega(2-omega), uniquely minimized at omega=1, giving unique smallest eigenvalue ratio. Diagonal 2x2 matrices are omega-independent. On the SPD 3-node path with 0<r<1/sqrt2 the natural order at omega=1 has one maximal generalized eigenvalue 1 and two roots in (0,1); implicit derivative gives lambda_min'(1)>0, lambda_max'(1)=0, so kappa'(1)<0. Center-first permutation has a fixed eigenvalue 1 and two roots with fixed product and sum minimized uniquely at omega=1, making omega=1 globally optimal. Independent exact SymPy rebuilt all three determinant identities and F_omega; at r=1/2 the condition derivative equals -1/8-23sqrt(17)/136.
